body:
## When do mattress Black Friday deals start?

Black Friday 2026 is on Friday 27 November and Cyber Monday is 30 November (our [Black Friday 2026 dates guide](/guides/when-is-black-friday-2026-uk/) has every retailer's start date). Mattress brands start much earlier. Emma's Black Friday prices went live on 27 October and its sale is due to end on Monday 30 November. Most online mattress brands, including Simba, Eve, Nectar and Otty, run a sale for most of the year, so the question is not *whether* there's a discount but whether the price is lower than usual.

## How to tell a real mattress deal from a fake one

Mattress 'was' prices are some of the least trustworthy in UK retail. Emma's own sale terms say its percentages are worked out from the lowest price in the 30 days before the offer, which is better than an RRP, but still not the same as 'the cheapest it's ever been'.

The price-tracking site Mattress Unboxed checks thousands of UK mattress prices daily. Its data from late September to mid-October showed that the own-shop prices of Simba, Nectar, Otty and the Emma Original double barely moved, while some short sales lasted only a week before prices went back up. Two examples:

- **Eve Premium double:** £569 on Eve's site from 30 September to 14 October, then back to £949.
- **Simba Hybrid double at Bensons for Beds:** £719.99 for a week in October, then back to £899.99.

So the rule is simple: look up the exact model and size on a price-history site before you buy, and compare the brand's own shop with third-party retailers. As our first deal shows, the brand's own site is often not the cheapest.

## Mattress prices to aim for this Black Friday

These are double-size prices from Mattress Unboxed's October data, which give a good guide to what a sale price looks like:

- **Budget pocket sprung (Sleepeezee Deluxe 1000, Mattress Online's Memory Zone 3000):** about £380–£430 is a good price.
- **Silentnight Miracoil Pillow Top:** £239 at Dreams in October, down from a usual £299. Under £250 is good.
- **Eve Premium:** aim for around £570, its October sale price. Don't pay £949.
- **Simba Hybrid:** about £720 at third-party retailers is the price to wait for.
- **Tempur Pro SmartCool:** £1,099 for a double was the October sale price, against a usual £1,399.

For king size, Emma Original at £423 and Sealy Mellbreak Ortho Plus at £474 (both above) are already strong prices.

## How to choose a mattress

- **Foam or springs?** Memory foam (Emma, Tempur) moulds to you and cuts down on movement from a partner, but can feel warm. Pocket springs (Sealy, Silentnight, Sleepeezee) feel firmer and bouncier and sleep cooler. Hybrids mix both.
- **Firmness:** side sleepers usually want medium to medium-soft; back and front sleepers, medium to firm. Heavier people generally need firmer support.
- **Trial and guarantee:** online brands offer long trials (Emma gives 200 nights and a 10-year guarantee). Shops selling traditional brands may offer shorter trials or charge for exchanges, so check before you buy.
- **Size:** measure your bed frame. A UK double is 135 x 190cm and a king is 150 x 200cm; EU sizes differ.

If you're also buying bedding or a new frame, our [Amazon Black Friday 2026 guide](/guides/amazon-black-friday-2026-uk/) covers what's cheap there. Or see [every Black Friday 2026 guide](/black-friday/) for other categories.

## Frequently asked questions

### Is it worth buying a mattress on Black Friday?

Yes, if the price is lower than its recent average, not just lower than the 'was' price. Many mattresses are on sale for most of the year, so check price history for your exact size first.

### When does the Emma Black Friday sale end?

Emma says its Black Friday sale, with up to 40% off, ends on Monday 30 November 2026.

### Are mattresses cheaper on Black Friday or in the January sales?

Prices are often similar. Brands run big sales in both periods, and the [Boxing Day sales](/guides/boxing-day-sales-2026-uk/) usually bring mattress discounts too. If you find a good price in November, there's little point waiting.

### Is it cheaper to buy an Emma mattress from Emma or another shop?

Not always from Emma. Today the Emma Original king is £423 at Mattress Next Day against £639 or more on Emma's site, so always compare.

### How long is a mattress trial?

It depends on the seller. Emma offers 200 nights. Some retailers offer 100 nights, and Silentnight offers 60 nights when you buy direct. Check whether returns are free.
